resources.string: Bean selection and dose confirmation
Saving a bean selection does not deduct stock; explicit dose confirmation deducts it only once
Choose stock batch
%1$s · %2$s g remaining · %3$s
Actual dose (g, up to 3 decimal places)
Save bean selection (no stock deduction)
Bean selection saved; stock has not been deducted
Confirm beans have been dosed and deduct stock
Retry confirmation with the same preparation record
%1$s g deducted from stock. A failed start will not return it automatically; corrections require an adjustment entry on the inventory page.
Dose confirmation is incomplete; stock may already have been deducted. Retrying checks the same event without deducting again. Do not create another preparation record to deduct it again.
Beans: %1$s\nBatch: %2$s\nActual dose: %3$s g
Preparation record %1$s
The previous dose is linked to a shot. Enter a new dose for the next shot; it will not be reused automatically.
Cancel bean selection and choose again
Explicitly abandon this preparation (no stock return)
Abandon current dose preparation
Stock transactions will be checked before this preparation record is abandoned. Any stock already deducted will not be returned; add an adjustment entry if a correction is needed.
Check transactions and abandon
Keep preparation
Return to brewing page
Capture current reading from the bean-weighing page
Beans can only be weighed when no brew is active or has an unknown result. Readings do not automatically deduct stock.
Service state is unconfirmed. You can enter the dose manually, but bean weighing is currently unavailable.
Bean weighing is unavailable while the current brew activity or recovery state remains unresolved
No usable real bean-weight reading. Weigh the beans again or enter the dose manually.
Enter an actual dose greater than 0, with up to 3 decimal places, within the supported range
No stock batches yet. Add a bag of beans first.
Add stock batch
Could not save the bean selection. Stock has not been deducted. Please try again later.
Dose confirmation is incomplete. Retry with the same preparation record, or explicitly check the transactions before abandoning it.
The preparation record has been kept. Transactions could not be checked or changes saved. Do not create another record to deduct again.
The preparation record has changed. Please check it again.
The preparation record and stock transactions do not match. Success cannot be confirmed. The original record has been kept.
Complete dose confirmation first, or explicitly abandon this bean selection on the preparation page.
Dose preparation data is unavailable. Check it on the preparation page first; original records will not be recreated or overwritten.
Stock deducted; the review link awaits recovery. No new preparation can be created until recovery, and stock will not be deducted again.
Restore this shot’s review link (fill empty fields only)
The review link has not been restored. The original preparation is kept. No fictional records will be created and stock will not be deducted again.
